body.purpose: Commands, output, paths, metadata, and explanations.

components.name: Session Masthead
components.description: A quiet identity row with one bright signal and dim session metadata.
components.css: .ds-masthead { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0; padding: 8px 16px; background: #161616; color: #f2f4f8; font: 14px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-masthead strong { color: #ee5396; font-weight: 700; } .ds-masthead small { margin-left: auto; color: #8d8d8d; font: inherit; }

components.name: Editor Frame
components.description: A shallow editor bounded by thin signal rules and a bright cursor.
components.css: .ds-editor { width: 100%; background: #161616; padding: 6px 0; } .ds-rule { height: 1px; background: #ee5396; } .ds-input { min-height: 28px; padding: 8px 0; color: #f2f4f8; font: 14px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-cursor { display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 16px; background: #f2f4f8; } .ds-editor:focus-within .ds-rule { background: #ff7eb6; }

components.name: Pricing Timeline
components.description: A one-row status with semantic color, glyph density, and dim transition metadata.
components.html: ● DeepSeek PEAK · Beijing [░░░░░░░░░▓▓█░░▓▓▓▓░░░░░░] · ends 01:00 local
components.css: .ds-timeline { padding: 8px 0; background: #161616; color: #8d8d8d; white-space: nowrap; font: 14px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-timeline strong, .ds-timeline b { color: #ee5396; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Selected Row
components.description: A full-width tonal selection with a small accent marker and quiet metadata.
components.css: .ds-selected-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 5px 8px; background: #393939; color: #f2f4f8; font: 14px/1 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-selected-row b { color: #ee5396; } .ds-selected-row span { color: #a8a8a8; } .ds-selected-row:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ee5396; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
The Signal Console is a quiet, cinematic terminal system. Most of the screen recedes into carbon and cool gray so the few active signals can carry real meaning. It favors breathing room, exact alignment, and stable information over dashboard density.

Precision comes from the terminal cell itself. Weight, contrast, box-drawn structure, and short labels create hierarchy without pretending the terminal is a desktop app. Color is operational. It identifies focus, state, and risk; it does not fill empty space.
keyCharacteristics: A carbon field with tonal structure instead of shadow.
Signal Magenta reserved for action, focus, and important warnings.
Monospace hierarchy built from weight, contrast, and alignment.
Responsive density that removes secondary detail before changing height.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Signal Magenta marks something active, actionable, or urgent. Never spend it on a whole pane or a decorative border.

rules.name: The Color Is Not Meaning Rule
rules.body: Every semantic color needs a word, glyph, shape, or stable position that communicates the same state.

rules.name: The One-Cell Rule
rules.body: Align text to terminal cells and keep labels short enough to scan without backtracking.

rules.name: The Stable Editor Rule
rules.body: Asynchronous state must not move the editor. Remove secondary detail before adding a row.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use contrast and containment to show depth. A terminal shadow is noise unless the host terminal draws the window itself.

dos: Do use Pi theme roles so every surface works across checked-in themes.
Do preserve primary state at narrow widths and remove optional metadata first.
Do pair semantic color with text, glyph density, or position.
Do leave empty carbon around important information when the terminal has room.
donts: Don't hard-code a new color when an existing semantic role expresses the state.
Don't turn every row into a bordered container.
Don't use Signal Magenta as ambient decoration.
Don't add asynchronous rows that move the editor.
Don't imitate web cards, pills, gradients, or shadows inside the TUI.
